Antibiotic.name: Antibiótico
Antibiotic.description: Si un objetivo ha comenzado el proceso de curación natural inyectándolos con antibióticos, cura 2 puntos adicionales por semana. Este efecto no se acumula.

Black Lace.name: Lazo Negro
Black Lace.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration


Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

Blue Glass.name: Cristal Azul
Blue Glass.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The GM may occasionally tell the user that they are seeing swirls of colours. When this happens the user loses their action on a single turn

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • The GM may occasionally tell the user that they are seeing swirls of colours. When this happens the user loses their action on a single turn

Boost.name: Boost
Boost.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user has INT +2 for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

  • INT -2

Rapidetox.name: Rapidetox
Rapidetox.description: Inyectar a un objetivo con Rapidetox eliminará los efectos de cualquier fármaco, veneno o intoxicante que sufra actualmente.

Smash.name: Smash
Smash.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The user feels happy and satisfied
  • +2 to Dance / Contortionist / Conversation / Human Perception / Persuasion / Acting

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 to Dance / Contortionist / Conversation / Human Perception / Persuasion / Acting
  • GM will tell your when you crave more Smash. Roleplay accordingly.

Speedheal.name: Speedheal
Speedheal.description: Inyectar a un objetivo con Speedheal inmediatamente hace que cura a un PV igual a su BODY más su WILL. Este efecto no funciona en objetivos heridos morales, y solo se puede usar en un objetivo una vez al día.

Stim.name: Stim
Stim.description: Inyectar a un objetivo con Stim hace que ignore todas las penalizaciones por heridas serias durante una hora. Solo se puede usar en un objetivo una vez al día.

Surge.name: Surge
Surge.description: Inyectar a un objetivo con Surge hace que sea inmune a la privación del sueño durante 24 horas. Solo se puede usar en un objetivo una vez por semana.

Synthcoke.name: Sintecoca
Synthcoke.description:
Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • +1 REF by 1 point for the duration
  • The user feels paranoid occasionally

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 REF unless under ther Primary Effect
  • GM will tell you when when you crave mor Synthcoke. Roleplay Acordingly
